PROJECTS
CVTailor
Apr 2026 FastAPI, Ollama, pgVector
CVTailor is an AI-powered CV tailoring engine that allows users to upload their CV, and paste a job description to automatically generate a semantically optimized, ATS-friendly version.

• Built a robust skills RAG system with 14,260+ skill embeddings (pgvector) sourced from ESCO, Tanova, and custom hierarchies, enabling vector similarity search, gap analysis, auto-fill, and related skill suggestions.

• Designed and implemented an asynchronous tailoring pipeline with Celery + Redis, incorporating CV normalization (NuExtract), multi-section rewriting (Llama 3.1), composite scoring (ATS, semantic, structural, readability), and transparent diff generation.
• Created intelligent agents for JD parsing, skill resolution, bullet improvement (SSE streaming), and AI co-pilot evaluation, with full support for reversible changes and user-controlled acceptance.
• Developed a full-stack application using FastAPI (REST + SSE), Next.js 16 dashboard, PostgreSQL with pgvector, JWT authentication (httpOnly cookies), and DOCX/JSON export functionality.

• Engineered production-ready features including Docker Compose deployment, Alembic migrations, interactive skill seeder, real-time progress tracking, and comprehensive scoring with weighted categories.
Vibecost
Jun 2026 PythonCLI, TikToken, HF Transformers

Vibecost is a command-line tool that helps developers estimate token usage, simulate costs, and predict AI agent behavior before running expensive LLM calls. It accurately scans projects, counts tokens using real tokenizers (tiktoken + HuggingFace), simulates multi-turn agent loops with reasoning tokens, and provides detailed cost breakdowns across 15 major models (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, DeepSeek, etc.). Key features include prompt prediction (files + MCP tools), visual cost comparison and context pressure visualization

• Created a smart prompt prediction engine that analyzes queries to recommend relevant files (keyword + content relevance scoring) and MCP tools (read/edit/write, grep, bash, etc.) with estimated token costs
NYON Engine
Jan 2026 ECS Architecture, OpenGL, C++17
Nyon is a high-performance 2D game engine featuring GPU-instanced rendering, a custom rigid-body physics engine, and an advanced particle system.

• Created a high-performance GPU-instanced OpenGL 4.6 renderer using persistent-mapped buffers, triple-buffering, and GLsync fences for efficient rendering of thousands of objects and up to 4 million particles.
• Engineered a multi-threaded architecture with a work-stealing ThreadPool, parallelizing broad-phase queries, narrow-phase collisions, physics solving, and particle updates.
• Developed four fully playable game demos (Breakout, Flappy Bird, Physics Sandbox, Tower Stack) showcasing core engine systems including input handling, camera following, and particle effects.
KhojAI
Oct 2025 Spring Boot, NextJS+Flutter, Advanced NLP
KhojAI is an intelligent, AI-powered search and chat application that combines a local LLM (Ollama) with real-time web search to deliver context-aware, factually grounded responses.
• Architected a multi-service system with Java Spring Boot backend (REST + SSE), Python FastAPI AI engine, Next.js web frontend, and Flutter mobile application.

• Built a sophisticated AI pipeline featuring hybrid prompt analysis (spaCy + KeyBERT + Ollama), intent detection (33 categories), intelligent query generation, concurrent web scraping (3 strategies), BM25 ranking, and token-streaming responses.
• Implemented real-time SSE streaming with 9 structured event types for live search progress visualization, partial response rendering, and smooth user experience.
• Engineered robust backend features including JWT authentication (ready-to-activate), PostgreSQL integration with JPA/Hibernate, reactive WebClient proxying, circuit breakers, and disk caching.
Mini-Commit Transformer
Oct 2025 Pytorch, Unigram+BPE, AI Algorithms
Mini-Commit Transformer is a compact Encoder-Decoder Transformer (36.6M parameters) trained entirely from scratch to automatically generate meaningful commit messages from code diffs.
• Developed novel architectural components including DiffEmbedding for injecting change-type features

• Engineered a highly memory-efficient training pipeline featuring mixed-precision (bfloat16), gradient checkpointing, gradient accumulation, curriculum learning, BucketBatchSampler, and EMA — enabling training on consumer-grade GPUs (e.g., AMD RX 6600).
• Conducted comprehensive inference benchmarking across 13 decoding strategies (Beam Search, Top-p, Top-k, Typical Sampling, etc.)
